warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on S-01 (หน้า17): numbers 1-13 along x (12 bays x 4.00 = 48.00) and letters A-F along y. Origin A1 (top-left as drawn).

A/B and E/F are printed as two nearly coincident bubble pairs: A sits 0.125 outside B (outer chain A-C 3.625 vs inner chain B-C 3.50) and F sits 0.125 outside E (D-F 2.525 vs D-E 2.40). Columns and footings sit on B/C/D/E only; A and F carry no member on S-01 (outer wall-face lines). Both are kept as named lines because they are printed bubbles.

Conflict: the top plan prints the overall x dimension 48.00, the column/footing plan prints 47.98, and both print every bay as 4.00 (12 x 4.00 = 48.00). Taken: 48.00 — twelve printed bays plus one overall on the top plan beat one overall figure; the 47.98 row is kept in dimension_chains as printed.

The left vertical dimensions 4.00 and 1.50 (top) and 1.50 (bottom) were read at 400 dpi: their tick strokes sit at the outer lines A / F, not at the column lines B / E (0.125 apart). Taken: they hang off A and F (A' -4.00, A''' -1.50, F'' 11.15); if they actually hang off B/E every one of these three dummies shifts by 0.125 m. Same reading for S-02's cantilever-edge dimensions 1.00 (top, A'''' -1.00), 1.00 and 2.27 (bottom, F' 10.65 / F'''' 11.92), and S-03's eave 2.05 (A'' -2.05 / F''' 11.70).

B''' and C'' (the B1 beam lines at the third points of the 7.00 B-D bay, grids 2-12) are not dimensioned on S-01. Positioned by proportion (span amendment, section 4): B + 7.00/3 and B + 2 x 7.00/3; a pixel scan of the scan measured 2.36 and 4.66 m below B. They carry their own lower confidence_score.
B' (B + 2.00) and C'' (C + 2.15) are printed only in end bay 1-2; end bay 12-13 is drawn as its mirror (G2 / G2 / B4A / B2 on the same lines) and uses the same lines.

Sweep coverage (honest): this op04 run was cut short by a scheduled shutdown, so only S-01 (หน้า17) S-02 (หน้า18, floors 2 and 3) and S-03 (หน้า19, roof) were swept into this master. The elevations/sections (A-sheets) and S-02..S-10 have not been swept for further ticks or levels; z_levels holds only the +0.15 printed on S-01. [2026-10-23 update: superseded for the architectural sheets — A-02..A-12 (หน้า04-14) are now swept: plan chains, sections ก/ข, elevations, stair/toilet details, every printed level in z_levels; see the warnings below. A-01 (หน้า03, material list -> unassigned) and E-01/E-02 (หน้า15-16, electrical plans) were swept in the same run. Not swept into this master: หน้า01-02 (cover pages, no dimension) and the structural detail sheets S-04..S-10 (หน้า20-26), whose numbers are member-internal and live in their section files (spec section 4 rule 4, "not an axis tick").]
Footing-plan note printed under แปลนเสา ฐานราก: 'กรณีที่ใช้ฐานรากแผ่ สภาพชั้นดินต้องรับน้ำหนักได้ไม่น้อยกว่า 8,000 กก./ตรม.' (not a dimension).

A-06 lettering reconciled by POSITION (2026-10-23 sweep): sections ก/ข print only four bubbles A, B, D, E. Their 'A' is the column line the 7.00 runs from (7.00 = B-D on S-01/A-02; A-D would be 7.125), so A-06 'A' = master B; A-06 'B' sits mid-way across the 7.00 with no tick on the chain = master C (B + 3.50); 'D' = D (D-E 2.40 matches); 'E' = E. A-07's stair plans/section use the same shifted lettering (A, C, D / A, B, D). No structural id was renamed; chains reference the master ids and their notes quote the printed letters. Risk accepted: if the section's 'A' was meant as the wall-face line A, its 7.00 would be 0.125 short — the chain arithmetic (7.00 + 2.40 = B-E) says column line.

Floor-level conflicts on the A-sheets (no structural sheet prints these levels, so there is no structural value to prefer — all kept as separate z_levels): floor 1 = +0.95 'ระดับพื้นชั้นล่าง' on the elevations A-04/A-05, but +0.85 on section ก ('ระดับพื้นทางเดินชั้นล่าง'), section ข (ห้องเรียน +0.85, chain 0.15 + 0.70) and +0.80 on section ข's ระเบียงทางเดิน and A-07; beam soffit 'ระดับท้องคาน' = +10.85 on A-06 but the A-04 rear elevation prints 'ระดับท้องคาน +11.45' where A-04 front/A-05 print 'ระดับหลังคาน +11.45'. Nothing in the extracted structural files references z_levels, so no span changes.

New y lines from the architectural sweep: E + 2.50 = 12.025 (A-02 floor-2 inner chain and A-06 section ก both run 2.50 from E to the entrance canopy/step edge; 0.105 from F'''' 11.92, so a separate line) and F'' + 1.25 = 12.40 (A-02 floor-1 step-out of the outline, printed left and right). Section ข's 1.50 and section ก's 1.00 have their inner tick at the wall face, apart from the E tick, so they reuse F'' / F' (same edges as S-01/S-02), not E + 1.50 / E + 1.00.

A-sheet sweep pages 09-14 (A-07..A-12, 2026-10-23): the stair sheet A-07 letters the classroom-block column lines A, C, D (plans) and A, B, D (section) — same shift as A-06, mapped by position ('A' = B, its 3.50 to C/'B' = B-C). Every A-07 stair chain lands on lines S-02 already had (B' 1.90, B'''' 2.65, C' 4.275, C'''' 5.775) — no new line. A-08's toilet plan draws the A/B pair as one line: its 3.63 is A-C (3.625, printed rounded) and its ~2.00 (approximate) is taken as the G2 wall line B'' (B + 2.00, S-01) — risk accepted: if the ~2.00 hangs off A it is a line at 2.000, 0.025 from B' (stair landing). The stair levels on A-07 (+0.80 / +4.30 / +7.80) are 0.05 below the same labels on A-06 (+0.85 / +4.35 / +7.85); both kept, A-07's ids carry the printed value. A-09..A-12 (door, window, blackboard wall, septic tank) print no grid bubbles: their numbers are member/fixture sizes and went to unassigned_dimensions.

Electrical sheets E-01/E-02 (หน้า15-16) swept too (2026-10-23): they reprint the plan chains with different outer values — A-C 3.58 (E-01 floor 1: 3.57) against 3.625 and D-F 2.48 against 2.525 on S-01/A-02/A-03 — and E-02 prints B-C 3.60 against 3.50 on every other sheet; E-02's last three x bubbles are misprinted '9', '10', '11' at the positions of 11, 12, 13. The structural/architectural values are kept (S-01 and the A-sheets agree with each other to the mm and close 3.625 = 3.50 + 0.125); the E-rows are recorded as printed and flagged by the mismatch notes below. No line moved.
